Table tennis reinvents China's beloved national sport with AI opponents and robotic servers for immersive training that boosts reflexes and reduces stress - where cutting-edge technology meets traditional passion.



>> Features of Ping Pong Simulator:


  • Robotic Serving System: Provides consistent and customizable ball delivery for various practice scenarios.

  • AI-Powered Opponents: Simulates realistic, adaptive opponents with adjustable difficulty levels.

  • Immersive Training: Enhances reflexes and hand-eye coordination through dynamic play sessions.

  • Real-Time Feedback: Tracks player performance, speed, accuracy, and movement with detailed analytics.

  • Multi-Mode Options: Supports training, challenge, and multiplayer competition modes.

  • Compact Design: Optimized for home use, training centers, or entertainment venues.



>> Advantages and Applications for the Ping Pong Simulator:


Reflex Training: Ideal for improving reaction time, precision, and coordination.


Stress Relief: A fun, engaging way to unwind while staying active.


Professional & Casual Use: Suitable for athletes, students, hobbyists, and fitness enthusiasts.

Cultural Connection: Honors the heritage of table tennis while offering a modern, digital twist.


Versatile Environments: Applicable in schools, clubs, arcades, homes, and rehabilitation centers.



>> Product Number: LJST006


  • Floor area: 5m*3m*3m

  • Number of people: 1 person

  • Participation time: 3-10 minutes

  • Power: 450w



>> FAQs for Ping Pong Simulator:


Q1: Who is this simulator suitable for?

A1: The Ping Pong Simulator is suitable for players of all levels—from beginners to professional athletes.


Q2: Do I need a real paddle to use the system?

A2: Yes, using a standard ping pong paddle is recommended for an authentic feel and accurate tracking.


Q3: Can the robot serve different spin types?

A3: Absolutely. The robotic server can simulate a wide variety of spin, speed, and direction settings.


Q4: Does it require a lot of space?

A4: No, the simulator is designed with a compact footprint and is suitable for home or small training spaces.


Q5: Can multiple players use the simulator?

A5: Yes, the system supports both solo training and competitive multiplayer modes.
